newsitem.title: UK: NWE vacuum gas oil supply thins, low sulphur firms.
newsitem.headline: NWE vacuum gas oil supply thins, low sulphur firms.

text.p: Low sulphur vacuum gas oil prices in Europe firmed from mid-week with supplies thinning slightly and refineries switching output to higher sulphur fuels, traders said.
High sulphur prices dropped back and were assessed at around $127 fob NWE. Two French cargoes of high sulphur VGO were reported placed.
The first, of 1.3 percent material, went on Wednesday at $126 fob a tonne, while the other -- 1.03 percent VGO -- went on Thursday at $128.

Traders said the market overall was thin with lots of supply cleaned up. One 45,000 tonne cargo of low sulphur was heard offered at $140 fob with bids for it so far hitting $137. Nothing was heard traded on Friday.
Shutdowns of desulphurisation plants in the ARA area had switched the production emphasis to high sulphur, one trader said.
Trans-Atlantic exports looked unprofitable for the moment, traders said, with supplies in the U.S. looking good and prices for VGO unattractive.
